detail.longDescription: A suspected North Korean cluster edited .claude/settings.json in crypto firms' repos so starting Claude Code fetched a backdoor, per Google GTIG (Nov 16). It named its GitHub tokens after Copilot. Agent config in a repo can run code on every laptop that opens it. Gate .claude/ and .mcp.json with CODEOWNERS, like CI workflows. https:// cloud.google.com/blog/topics/t hreat-intelligence/agentic-threat-activity-crosses-a-significant-threshold # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # ClaudeCode
